notes: Read the web source line by line. Preserved the SavingsSlide({ data }: Props) signature and Props { data: YearReview } (source L7-11) by importing the real YearReview from the converted ../../../../api/types. Reproduced every derivation verbatim: gasCostEquiv = data.gas_savings + data.total_charging_cost (L14) plus light null safety via an inlined `safe` (nullish/non-finite -> 0) so gasSavings/totalChargingCost mirror the web required-number reads.

framer-motion entrances (source L18-25 motion.span spring scale 0->1 / rotate -15->0; L27-34 motion.p fade + slide-up delay 0.2; L36-47 motion.div spring scale 0.5->1 delay 0.4; L49-56 motion.p fade delay 0.8; L59-96 motion.div slide-up delay 1) have no native equivalent and, following the established conversion idiom (OverviewTab <FadeIn>, DriveScore framer-motion), render in their final rest state (opacity 1, translateY 0, scale 1, rotate 0) — visually identical at rest. @/components/motion is not imported.

@/components/data-display AnimatedNumber (source L41-46: value=data.gas_savings, duration=1.5, prefix='$', emerald-400 6xl/8xl bold) is inlined as a native AnimatedNumber reproducing the exact ease-out-quad count-up `1-(1-progress)^2` from 0 to value over duration*1000ms via requestAnimationFrame, using Date.now() because React Native has no performance.now(); the frame is cancelled on unmount. Same prefix/suffix/decimals/format contract; fmtNumber mirrors web lib/numberFormat (en-US grouping, default 0 decimals as AnimatedNumber passes).

lucide-react Fuel (L67 text-red-400/70), Zap (L78 text-emerald-400/70) and DollarSign (L91 text-emerald-400) 16px icons -> small colour-coded IconDot markers; the native SemanticIcon primitive's fixed tones (fuel/bolt=warning amber, dollarSign=success green) would drop the source's deliberate red=cost / emerald=savings coding, so the exact red-400/emerald-400 hues (with /80,/70,/60 opacity variants and the white/[0.06] track) are used verbatim — the same idiom OverviewTab used for the CB-safe CHART_COLORS palette. text-secondary/text-muted map to theme tokens.

Comparison block (source L58-96): max-w-xs/space-y-4 -> bars View (maxWidth 320, width 100%, alignSelf center, gap). Row 1 'Gas would cost' (L65-74): IconDot + secondary label + ml-auto red value `$${Math.round(gasCostEquiv)}` over a full-width red-400/60 fill on a white/[0.06] rounded track. Row 2 'Electric cost' (L76-88): IconDot + secondary label + ml-auto emerald value `$${Math.round(data.total_charging_cost)}` over an emerald-400/60 fill whose width = gasCostEquiv>0 ? Math.round(total_charging_cost/gasCostEquiv*100)% : 0% (L85). Row 3 (L90-95): centered IconDot + emerald-400/80 savingsNote.

i18n intent preserved: react-i18next useTranslation -> a native English-default `t` keeping every key verbatim — yearReview.youSaved (L33), yearReview.vsGas (L55), yearReview.gasCost (L68), yearReview.electricCost (L79). The savingsNote object form (L93) reproduces i18next's `{{cupsOfCoffee}}` interpolation against Math.round(data.gas_savings/5) with the exact defaultValue "That's {{cupsOfCoffee}} cups of coffee!".

Layout maps the container (source L17 flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full px-8 text-center) to a flex:1 centered View (paddingHorizontal 32 = px-8); the 💰 emoji (L24, text-6xl mb-6), 'You saved' eyebrow (text-lg uppercase tracking-wider mb-4), headline number, and 'vs gas' sub-line (mt-2 mb-8) keep their sizes/spacing. No DOM, framer-motion, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI imports. Verified with cd apps/native; npm run typecheck; npm run lint -- --quiet; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
